text:
alex: Quick preflight — AP-SOUTH1 bring-up. Cloud quoted a regional GPU quota but wants a reservation plan before we commit. Need to agree reservation sizes, bootstrap tests, and a handoff timeline. Who can take action on quotas?
maria: Can you paste the quota numbers we got? Also need rough cost estimate to include in the request.
cheng: From cloud support: regional GPU quota = 120 A100s. Per-project default = 40. Support can grant a reservation hold for up to 30 days while we validate, but needs exact instance count + start date.
ops-bot: Ticket #INC-9245 created: "AP-SOUTH1 GPU quota reservation request" — link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-9245
sam: My plan: create two reservations for bring-up: `bootstrap-pool` (16 A100s) to run infra + validation CI, and `canary-pool` (8 A100s) for customer-facing traffic soak. Leave remaining quota unreserved for burst. Example command to request reservation: ```gcloud compute reservations create bootstrap-pool --zone=ap-south1-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=count=16,type=nvidia-tesla-a100 --project=redwood-dev --description="bringup bootstrap"```
alex: That makes sense. Maria, can you run numbers on cost at the reservation sizes above? Need hourly and a 30-day projection (we won't run 100% all month but use estimate).
linda: Roughs: A100 region list price ~ $2.40/hr (varies). For 24 GPUs reserved (16+8) that's ~ $57.6/hr. Over 30 days constant that's ~ $41k. With realistic 40% utilization that becomes ~$16.5k. Also verify any reserved-instance discounts or committed use discounts with finance.
maria: I'll add a line item for network egress and peering. We also need L3/VPC peering set up: ap-south1 needs a cross-project peering and a firewall allowing control-plane ranges.
cheng: Networking gotcha: cloud imposes a per-VPC forwarding rule limit and we hit that in ap-south historically — ask network to validate NAT IP pool and interconnect. Also ensure subnets sized for node pools (16+ nodes) and IP ranges for pods if using Calico.
sam: Validation checklist (short): 1) Reservation granted + instances visible 2) kube nodes register 3) `nvidia-smi` shows GPUs 4) run small perf job (1M token echo) 5) run KV-cache warmup test 6) run 5 min soak at 10 RPS from canary pool 7) collect logs/trace and cost telemetry
alex: Can someone draft a short handoff checklist to Eng-Oncall & Customer Success once bootstrap passes? We should include rollback plan and fallback region (ap-southeast1).
maria: I'll draft and attach to the ticket. Also asking finance to pre-approve up to $25k burn for the 30-day window.
linda: FYI — if cloud requires payment method verification for reservation, ping me and I'll approve with finance.
cheng: One more: quota APIs need the precise machine type string — cloud returns `a2-highgpu-1g`, but our runtime prefers `a2-megahighgpu` in certain kernels. We'll request both vendors to map quotas to the exact machine types we need.
sam: For the actual reservation request, use the tag `bringup:ap-south1` and include `owner:eng-infra` — helps with billing and cleanup scripts.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1893456840 — please update ticket INC-9245 with reservation request payload before EOD.
alex: Cool — action items: Maria (cost + ticket updates), Cheng (network & machine-type mapping), Sam (reservation request + validation jobs), Linda (finance signoff). Target: reservation request submitted by EOD, bootstrap validation tomorrow AM.
_meta: This thread is a short operations sync about GPU quota reservation and bootstrap validation for a new region. Messages are in chronological order and mirror typical Slack brevity (commands, short checklists, bot notices).
